## 1. DGA comparison (2024-01-15 → 2024-01-18, last sample in window)

| Gas | First (01-15) | Last (01-18) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| CO | 32 ppm | 33 ppm | +1 ppm |
| Ethylene (C2H4) | 16,684 ppm | 16,600 ppm | −84 ppm |
| Methane (CH4) | 7,406 ppm | 7,350 ppm | −56 ppm |

The thermal gases are extremely high but essentially flat; CO is low and stable (~32–33 ppm).

## 2. Fault classification (last sample)

The LLM-backed `interpret_dga` tool was unavailable after repeated retries, so I applied the IEC 60599 Rogers Ratio method manually (H2 2900, CH4 7350, C2H2 7, C2H4 16600, C2H6 5450):

- C2H2/C2H4 = 7/16600 = 0.0004 → ratio code **0**
- CH4/H2 = 7350/2900 = 2.53 → ratio code **2**
- C2H4/C2H6 = 16600/5450 = 3.05 → ratio code **1**
- Code **0-2-1 → T2 thermal fault** (300–700 °C, no paper involvement indicated). C2H2 is low (7 ppm), which rules out T3/high-energy arcing.

**Paper involvement cannot be confirmed** — CO is low and essentially flat (~33 ppm), so there is no evidence of cellulose degradation. This is not T2/T3-with-paper.

## 3. Existing work orders on Transformer 1

Only one open/pending WO exists: **1000051** — "OLTC inspection – Transformer 1 on-load tap changer (suspected contact wear/coking)" (PdM, WAPPR, priority 1). It is **not** an oil sample retest or insulation check, so a new WO is warranted (no duplicate).

## 4. Work order creation — blocked

I attempted to create the corrective WO (oil sample retest + insulation check) but the work-order system returned **403 Forbidden**, so it could not be created. Details intended:

- **Description**: Transformer 1 oil sample retest (DGA) and insulation condition check — T2 thermal fault per Rogers code 0-2-1 (ethylene ~16,600 ppm, methane ~7,350 ppm); paper involvement unconfirmed (CO ~33 ppm stable)
- **Priority**: **3** (classification is T2 thermal, but paper involvement is not confirmed — not the T2/T3-with-paper case that warrants priority 2)
- **Failure code**: **FC006** ("overheating or high temperature reading") — best match in the FCC catalog for the thermal fault
- **Start date**: **2026-10-01** (0 work orders currently scheduled at MAIN in the next 7 days)
- **Technician**: Could not be assigned — **no technician has previously worked on Transformer 1** (WO 1000051 has no assigned labor), so the "fewest open WOs among prior Transformer 1 technicians" rule has no candidates to choose from. (For reference, MECHTECH2 and HVACTECH1 are the only technicians with any MAIN work orders.)

Please retry the creation once the work-order service permissions are restored, or assign manually using the parameters above.
